+

+// Qwen35MoE (the Qwen3.6 GGUF uses this arch):

+// x_L = RMSNorm(attention_L + residual_L, attn_post_norm_L, eps).

+// logits = W*x, p = softmax(logits), ids = topk(p); no gate_inp_b,

+// no exp_probs_b, no groups. Selected weights are normalized AFTER top-k.

+// softmax is monotone, so ranking logits gives the same IDs (ties by ID).

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_init() {

+    if (!expert_config.pregate) { return; }

+    try {

+        if (model.arch != LLM_ARCH_QWEN35MOE || model.hparams.n_expert_groups > 1 || !loras->empty() || !model.hdmd.rot.empty()) {

+            throw std::runtime_error("pregate requires qwen35moe without groups, LoRA, or folded rotations");

+        }

+        expert_pregate_before = expert_config.order == "before";

+        expert_pregate_k = expert_config.k;

+        expert_pregate_layers.resize(model.hparams.n_layer()); // excludes unexecuted MTP blocks

+        const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

+        if (page <= 0) { throw std::runtime_error("invalid page size"); }

+        // Decode/copy from file once, never GPU tensor data. Original mmap may have holes.

+        for (size_t il = 1; il < expert_pregate_layers.size(); ++il) {

+            const auto * w = model.layers[il].ffn_gate_inp;

+            llama_model::expert_file_range info;

+            if (!w || !ggml_is_contiguous(w) || w->ne[0] != model.hparams.n_embd ||

+                    w->ne[1] != model.hparams.n_expert || w->ne[2] != 1 || w->ne[3] != 1 ||

+                    !model.expert_file_info(w, info, false)) {

+                throw std::runtime_error("router file offsets/layout unavailable");

+            }

+            const auto * traits = ggml_get_type_traits(w->type);

+            if (w->type != GGML_TYPE_F32 && !traits->to_float) {

+                throw std::runtime_error("router type has no CPU decoder");

+            }

+            auto & dst = expert_pregate_layers[il].router;

+            dst.resize(ggml_nelements(w));

+            const size_t first = info.offset / size_t(page) * size_t(page);

+            const size_t delta = info.offset - first, len = delta + ggml_nbytes(w);

+            void * ptr = mmap(nullptr, len, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, info.source_fd, off_t(first));

+            if (ptr == MAP_FAILED) { throw std::runtime_error("router file mmap failed"); }

+            const char * data = static_cast<const char *>(ptr) + delta;

+            if (w->type == GGML_TYPE_F32) { memcpy(dst.data(), data, ggml_nbytes(w)); }

+            else {

+                for (int64_t row = 0; row < w->ne[1]; ++row) {

+                    traits->to_float(data + row * w->nb[1], dst.data() + row * w->ne[0], w->ne[0]);

+                }

+            }

+            munmap(ptr, len);

+        }

+        expert_pregate_enabled = true;

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: active k=%zu arch=qwen35moe gating=softmax router=file-cpu-copy order=%s\n",

+            expert_pregate_k, expert_pregate_before ? "before" : "after");

+    } catch (const std::exception & e) {

+        expert_pregate_layers.clear();

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: inactive (%s)\n", e.what());

+    }

+}

+

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_arrive(size_t il, const std::vector<int32_t> & selected) {

+    if (!expert_fill_decode || !expert_fill_this_ubatch || il >= expert_pregate_layers.size()) { return; }

+    auto & current = expert_pregate_layers[il];

+    // Gather both distances before sampling. Each file's entire arrival snapshot

+    // and cancellation share its dispatch lock, so queued means cancelled.

+    std::map<ExpertFiller *, std::vector<ExpertFiller::Async>> observed;

+    for (const auto & predictions : current.predictions) {

+        for (const auto & prediction : predictions) {

+            for (const auto & b : prediction.batches) { observed[b.first].push_back(b.second); }

+        }

+    }

+    std::map<const ExpertFiller::AsyncBatch *, ExpertFiller::AsyncState> snapshots;

+    for (auto & entry : expert_fillers) {

+        auto & batches = observed[entry.second.get()];

+        const auto states = entry.second->arrive_async_through(il, batches);

+        for (size_t i = 0; i < batches.size(); ++i) { snapshots[batches[i].get()] = states[i]; }

+    }

+

+    for (size_t d = 0; d < expert_config.lookahead; ++d) {

+        const auto & predictions = current.predictions[d];

+        if (predictions.empty()) { continue; }

+        ++pregate_arrivals;

+        pregate_actual += selected.size(); pregate_predicted += predictions.size();

+        pregate_actual_d[d] += selected.size();

+        uint64_t pending = 0, running = 0;

+        for (const auto & prediction : predictions) {

+            const bool hit = std::find(selected.begin(), selected.end(), prediction.id) != selected.end();

+            pregate_hits += hit; pregate_hits_d[d] += hit;

+            ExpertFiller::AsyncState state;

+            for (const auto & b : prediction.batches) { state += snapshots.at(b.second.get()); }

+            pregate_timeliness.record(ExpertFiller::classify(prediction.resident_at_predict, state), hit);

+            pending += state.pending; running += state.running;

+        }

+        pregate_pending_reads += pending;

+        pregate_inflight_reads += running; pregate_inflight_arrivals += pending != 0;

+    }

+    // Arrival snapshot/cancellation above always precedes demand, independent of ORDER.

+}

+

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_hook(size_t il, const ggml_tensor * t) {

+    if (!expert_fill_decode || !expert_fill_this_ubatch || expert_pregate_failed ||

+            il + 1 >= expert_pregate_layers.size()) { return; }

+    try {

+        if (!loras->empty()) { throw std::runtime_error("LoRA activated after pregate initialization"); }

+        // Before-node CPU callback runs AFTER the scheduler's host copies and prefix

+        // synchronize. src[1] of the FIRST gate/up MUL_MAT_ID is [embd,1,1,1],

+        // a reshape/host copy of attn_post_norm, not the down-projection activation.

+        const ggml_tensor * x = t->src[1];

+        const ggml_tensor * base = x && x->view_src ? x->view_src : x;

+        const auto * w = model.layers[il + 1].ffn_gate_inp;

+        if (!x || !base || !base->buffer || !ggml_backend_buffer_is_host(base->buffer) ||

+                !x->data || x->type != GGML_TYPE_F32 || x->ne[0] != w->ne[0] ||

+                x->ne[1] != 1 || x->ne[2] != 1 || x->ne[3] != 1 || !ggml_is_contiguous(x) ||

+                (t->src[0] != model.layers[il].ffn_up_exps && t->src[0] != model.layers[il].ffn_gate_exps &&

+                 t->src[0] != model.layers[il].ffn_gate_up_exps)) {

+            throw std::runtime_error("first expert input is not a host F32 decode MoE vector");

+        }

+        const auto * input = static_cast<const float *>(x->data);

+        // Submit all L+1 experts before L+2; the pool also sorts queued work by

+        // target-layer deadline, so a later L+1 submission outranks old L+2 work.

+        for (size_t distance = 1; distance <= expert_config.lookahead && il + distance < expert_pregate_layers.size(); ++distance) {

+            const size_t target = il + distance;

+            const auto * router_weight = model.layers[target].ffn_gate_inp;

+            const auto & router = expert_pregate_layers[target].router;

+            std::vector<std::pair<float, int32_t>> logits;

+            logits.reserve(router_weight->ne[1]);

+            for (int64_t e = 0; e < router_weight->ne[1]; ++e) {

+                float dot = 0;

+                for (int64_t j = 0; j < router_weight->ne[0]; ++j) { dot += router[e * router_weight->ne[0] + j] * input[j]; }

+                if (!std::isfinite(dot)) { throw std::runtime_error("nonfinite pregate logits"); }

+                logits.emplace_back(dot, int32_t(e));

+            }

+            const size_t k = std::min(expert_pregate_k, logits.size());

+            std::partial_sort(logits.begin(), logits.begin() + k, logits.end(), [](const auto & a, const auto & b) {

+                return a.first != b.first ? a.first > b.first : a.second < b.second;

+            });

+            auto & next = expert_pregate_layers[target];

+            auto & predictions = next.predictions[distance - 1];

+            predictions.clear();

+            const auto & layer = model.layers[target];

+            for (size_t i = 0; i < k; ++i) {

+                ExpertFiller::Prediction prediction;

+                prediction.id = logits[i].second;

+                std::map<size_t, std::vector<ExpertFiller::Range>> ranges;

+                for (const ggml_tensor * expert : {layer.ffn_gate_exps, layer.ffn_up_exps, layer.ffn_down_exps, layer.ffn_gate_up_exps}) {

+                    if (!expert) { continue; }

+                    llama_model::expert_file_range info;

+                    if (!model.expert_file_info(expert, info)) { throw std::runtime_error("pregate expert offsets unavailable"); }

+                    const auto id = prediction.id;

+                    if (id < 0 || id >= expert->ne[2]) { throw std::runtime_error("pregate expert ID outside tensor"); }

+                    ranges[info.file_index].push_back({info.offset + size_t(id) * expert->nb[2], expert->nb[2]});

+                }

+                // Residency at prediction time is distinct from completed IO.

+                // Probe all files before publishing jobs for this expert.

+                std::vector<size_t> cold;

+                for (const auto & entry : ranges) {

+                    if (expert_fillers.at(entry.first)->nonresident(entry.second)) { cold.push_back(entry.first); }

+                }

+                for (const auto & entry : ranges) {

+                    auto & filler = *expert_fillers.at(entry.first);

+                    prediction.enqueue(filler, entry.second, target, [&](const auto &) {

+                        return std::find(cold.begin(), cold.end(), entry.first) == cold.end();

+                    }, distance);

+                }

+                next.predicted.push_back(prediction.id);

+                predictions.push_back(std::move(prediction));

+            }

+            ++pregate_predictions;

+        }

+    } catch (const std::exception & e) {

+        ++pregate_skips; expert_pregate_failed = true;

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: prediction disabled (%s)\n", e.what());

+    }

+}

+

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_stats() {

+    uint64_t bytes=0, reads=0, errors=0, dropped=0, cancelled_jobs=0, cancelled_bytes=0, demand_ns=0;

+    for (auto & entry : expert_fillers) {

+        entry.second->wait_async(); // teardown only, after graph synchronize

+        demand_ns += entry.second->counters().total_fill_wall_ns;

+        const auto c = entry.second->async_counters();

+        bytes += c.bytes_read; reads += c.read_syscalls; errors += c.errors; dropped += c.dropped;

+        cancelled_jobs += c.cancelled_jobs; cancelled_bytes += c.cancelled_bytes;

+    }

+    const auto & t = pregate_timeliness;

+    LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: stats predictions=%" PRIu64 " arrivals=%" PRIu64

+        " hits=%" PRIu64 " actual=%" PRIu64 " predicted=%" PRIu64 " recall_at_k=%.6f precision=%.6f"

+        " async_bytes_read=%" PRIu64 " async_reads=%" PRIu64 " async_errors=%" PRIu64 " dropped=%" PRIu64

+        " cancelled_jobs=%" PRIu64 " cancelled_bytes=%" PRIu64

+        " inflight_at_arrival=%" PRIu64 " inflight_reads=%" PRIu64 " pending_reads=%" PRIu64

+        " sync_bytes_with_prediction=%" PRIu64 " sync_bytes_without_prediction=%" PRIu64

+        " sync_calls_with_prediction=%" PRIu64 " sync_calls_without_prediction=%" PRIu64 " skips=%" PRIu64

+        " pred_done=%" PRIu64 " pred_inflight=%" PRIu64 " pred_queued=%" PRIu64 " pred_resident_at_predict=%" PRIu64

+        " hit_done=%" PRIu64 " hit_inflight=%" PRIu64 " hit_queued=%" PRIu64 " hit_resident=%" PRIu64

+        " recall_at_k_d1=%.6f recall_at_k_d2=%.6f actual_d1=%" PRIu64 " actual_d2=%" PRIu64

+        " hits_d1=%" PRIu64 " hits_d2=%" PRIu64

+        " demand_wait_ns_total=%" PRIu64 " demand_wait_ns_per_token=%.3f\n",

+        pregate_predictions, pregate_arrivals, pregate_hits, pregate_actual, pregate_predicted,

+        pregate_actual ? double(pregate_hits)/pregate_actual : 0.0,

+        pregate_predicted ? double(pregate_hits)/pregate_predicted : 0.0,

+        bytes, reads, errors, dropped, cancelled_jobs, cancelled_bytes, pregate_inflight_arrivals, pregate_inflight_reads, pregate_pending_reads,

+        pregate_sync_with, pregate_sync_without, pregate_calls_with, pregate_calls_without, pregate_skips,

+        t.pred_done, t.pred_inflight, t.pred_queued, t.pred_resident_at_predict,

+        t.hit_done, t.hit_inflight, t.hit_queued, t.hit_resident,

+        pregate_actual_d[0] ? double(pregate_hits_d[0])/pregate_actual_d[0] : 0.0,

+        pregate_actual_d[1] ? double(pregate_hits_d[1])/pregate_actual_d[1] : 0.0,

+        pregate_actual_d[0], pregate_actual_d[1], pregate_hits_d[0], pregate_hits_d[1],

+        demand_ns, expert_demand_tokens ? double(demand_ns)/expert_demand_tokens : 0.0);

+}

+

+static uint64_t expert_diag_now() {

+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(

+        std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();

+}

+void llama_context::expert_diag_close_gap() {

+    if (!expert_diag_gap) { return; }

+    struct rusage r {}; getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &r);

+    expert_diag_token.between_ns += expert_diag_now() - expert_diag_gap_ns;

+    expert_diag_token.majflt_between += r.ru_majflt - expert_diag_gap_maj;

+    expert_diag_token.minflt_between += r.ru_minflt - expert_diag_gap_min;

+    expert_diag_gap = false;

+}

+void llama_context::expert_diag_finish_token() {

+    if (!expert_diag_enabled || !expert_diag_token_active) { return; }

+    expert_diag_close_gap();

+    const auto & d = expert_diag_token;

+    expert_diag_total.fill_ns += d.fill_ns;

+    expert_diag_total.between_ns += d.between_ns;

+    expert_diag_total.majflt_fill += d.majflt_fill;

+    expert_diag_total.minflt_fill += d.minflt_fill;

+    expert_diag_total.majflt_between += d.majflt_between;

+    expert_diag_total.minflt_between += d.minflt_between;

+    expert_diag_total.thread_majflt += d.thread_majflt;

+    expert_diag_total.thread_minflt += d.thread_minflt;

+    expert_diag_total.post_nonresident += d.post_nonresident;

+    expert_diag_total.pre_use_nonresident += d.pre_use_nonresident;

+    expert_diag_total.next_nonresident += d.next_nonresident;

+    expert_diag_total.bytes_read += d.bytes_read;

+    expert_diag_total.post_checks += d.post_checks;

+    expert_diag_total.pre_use_checks += d.pre_use_checks;

+    expert_diag_total.next_checks += d.next_checks;

+    expert_diag_total.populate_calls += d.populate_calls;

+    expert_diag_total.populate_ns += d.populate_ns;

+    expert_diag_total.populate_errors += d.populate_errors;

+    if (expert_diag_csv) {

+        fprintf(expert_diag_csv, "%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu\n",

+            (unsigned long long)expert_diag_token_idx, (unsigned long long)d.fill_ns,

+            (unsigned long long)d.between_ns, (unsigned long long)d.majflt_fill,

+            (unsigned long long)d.majflt_between, (unsigned long long)d.post_nonresident,

+            (unsigned long long)d.pre_use_nonresident, (unsigned long long)d.bytes_read);

+        fflush(expert_diag_csv);

+    }

+    if (expert_diag_token_idx % 16 == 0) {

+        fprintf(stderr, "expert_fill: diag token=%llu fill_ns=%llu between_ns=%llu majflt_fill=%llu majflt_between=%llu post_nonresident=%llu pre_use_nonresident=%llu bytes_read=%llu\n",

+            (unsigned long long)expert_diag_token_idx, (unsigned long long)d.fill_ns,

+            (unsigned long long)d.between_ns, (unsigned long long)d.majflt_fill,

+            (unsigned long long)d.majflt_between, (unsigned long long)d.post_nonresident,

+            (unsigned long long)d.pre_use_nonresident, (unsigned long long)d.bytes_read);

+    }

+    expert_diag_token = {}; expert_diag_token_active = false;

+    expert_diag_layers.clear(); expert_diag_previous.clear();

+}

+void llama_context::expert_diag_pre_use(size_t il) {

+    if (!expert_diag_enabled || !expert_diag_token_active) { return; }

+    auto it = expert_diag_layers.find(il);

+    if (it == expert_diag_layers.end()) { return; }

+    for (const auto & entry : it->second) {

+        expert_diag_token.pre_use_nonresident += expert_fillers.at(entry.first)->nonresident(entry.second);

+        ++expert_diag_token.pre_use_checks;

+    }

+}

+void llama_context::expert_fill_phase(uint32_t n_tokens) {

+    if (expert_diag_enabled) {

+        expert_diag_finish_token();

+        if (n_tokens == 1) {

+            ++expert_diag_token_idx; expert_diag_token_active = true;

+            struct rusage r {}; getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &r);

+            expert_diag_gap_maj = r.ru_majflt; expert_diag_gap_min = r.ru_minflt;

+            expert_diag_gap_ns = expert_diag_now(); expert_diag_gap = true;

+        }

+    }

+    expert_fill_decode = n_tokens == 1;

+    expert_fill_this_ubatch = n_tokens >= expert_fill_min_tokens &&

+        (!expert_fill_max_tokens || n_tokens <= expert_fill_max_tokens);

+    if (!expert_fill_enabled || expert_fill_failed || !expert_fill_random_decode ||

+            expert_fill_random_applied || !expert_fill_decode) { return; }

+    // Transition before the first single-token graph, including when fill is filtered out.

+    expert_fill_random_applied = true;

+    const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

+    bool ok = page > 0;

+    for (const auto & layer : model.layers) {

+        for (const ggml_tensor * w : {layer.ffn_gate_exps, layer.ffn_up_exps, layer.ffn_down_exps, layer.ffn_gate_up_exps}) {

+            if (!w) { continue; }

+            llama_model::expert_file_range info;

+            if (!ok || !model.expert_file_info(w, info)) { ok = false; continue; }

+            const size_t first = info.offset - info.offset % size_t(page);

+            const size_t end = info.offset + ggml_nbytes(w);

+            const size_t pad = (size_t(page) - end % size_t(page)) % size_t(page);

+            const size_t last = end + std::min(pad, info.mapping_size - end);

+            if (madvise(static_cast<char *>(info.mapping) + first, last - first, MADV_RANDOM)) { ok = false; }

+        }

+    }

+    if (ok) {

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_fill: random advice applied at decode\n");

+    } else {

+        expert_fill_failed = true;

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_fill: inactive (decode random advice failed)\n");

+    }

+}

+

+void llama_context::expert_fill_selected(size_t il, const std::vector<int32_t> & selected) {

+    if (expert_fill_failed || !expert_fill_this_ubatch) { return; }

+    try {

+        std::map<size_t, std::vector<ExpertFiller::Range>> ranges;

+        const auto & layer = model.layers[il];

+        for (const ggml_tensor * w : {layer.ffn_gate_exps, layer.ffn_up_exps, layer.ffn_down_exps, layer.ffn_gate_up_exps}) {

+            if (!w) { continue; }

+            llama_model::expert_file_range info;

+            if (!model.expert_file_info(w, info)) { throw std::runtime_error("expert mmap/file offsets unavailable"); }

+            for (const auto id : selected) {

+                if (id < 0 || id >= w->ne[2] || size_t(id) > (SIZE_MAX - info.offset) / w->nb[2]) {

+                    throw std::runtime_error("expert slice out of bounds");

+                }

+                ranges[info.file_index].push_back({info.offset + size_t(id) * w->nb[2], w->nb[2]});

+            }

+        }

+        const bool diag = expert_diag_enabled && expert_diag_token_active;

+        struct rusage before {}, after {}, thread_before {}, thread_after {};

+        uint64_t start = 0;

+        if (diag) {

+            // Previous layer was consumed; this is a separate, after-use eviction probe.

+            for (const auto & entry : expert_diag_previous) {

+                expert_diag_token.next_nonresident += expert_fillers.at(entry.first)->nonresident(entry.second);

+                ++expert_diag_token.next_checks;

+            }

+            expert_diag_close_gap();

+            getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &before); getrusage(RUSAGE_THREAD, &thread_before);

+            start = expert_diag_now();

+        }

+        for (const auto & entry : ranges) {

+            auto & filler = *expert_fillers.at(entry.first);

+            ExpertFiller::Counters a {};

+            if (diag) { a = filler.counters(); }

+            const uint64_t sync_bytes = filler.fill(entry.second, expert_fill_decode);

+            if (expert_pregate_enabled && expert_fill_decode && il < expert_pregate_layers.size()) {

+                const bool predicted = !expert_pregate_layers[il].predicted.empty();

+                (predicted ? pregate_sync_with : pregate_sync_without) += sync_bytes;

+                ++(predicted ? pregate_calls_with : pregate_calls_without);

+            }

+            if (diag) {

+                const auto b = filler.counters();

+                expert_diag_token.bytes_read += b.bytes_read - a.bytes_read;

+                expert_diag_token.thread_majflt += b.thread_majflt - a.thread_majflt;

+                expert_diag_token.thread_minflt += b.thread_minflt - a.thread_minflt;

+                expert_diag_token.populate_calls += b.populate_calls - a.populate_calls;

+                expert_diag_token.populate_ns += b.populate_ns - a.populate_ns;

+                expert_diag_token.populate_errors += b.populate_errors - a.populate_errors;

+                expert_diag_token.post_nonresident += filler.nonresident(entry.second);

+                ++expert_diag_token.post_checks;

+            }

+        }

+        if (diag) {

+            getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &after); getrusage(RUSAGE_THREAD, &thread_after);

+            expert_diag_token.fill_ns += expert_diag_now() - start;

+            expert_diag_token.majflt_fill += after.ru_majflt - before.ru_majflt;

+            expert_diag_token.minflt_fill += after.ru_minflt - before.ru_minflt;

+            expert_diag_token.thread_majflt += thread_after.ru_majflt - thread_before.ru_majflt;

+            expert_diag_token.thread_minflt += thread_after.ru_minflt - thread_before.ru_minflt;

+            expert_diag_layers[il] = ranges; expert_diag_previous = ranges;

+            getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &after);

+            expert_diag_gap_maj = after.ru_majflt; expert_diag_gap_min = after.ru_minflt;

+            expert_diag_gap_ns = expert_diag_now(); expert_diag_gap = true;

+        }

+    } catch (const std::exception & e) {

+        expert_fill_failed = true;

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_fill: inactive (%s)\n", e.what());

+    }

+}

+#endif

+

+void llama_context::expert_prefetch_advise(size_t il, int32_t id) {

+#ifdef __linux__

+    auto & state = expert_prefetch_layers[il];

+    for (auto it = state.recent.begin(); it != state.recent.end();) {

+        if (state.tokens - it->second >= 32) {

+            it = state.recent.erase(it);

+        } else {

+            if (it->first == id) {

+                const auto hit = *it;

+                state.recent.erase(it);

+                state.recent.push_back(hit);

+                return;

+            }

+            ++it;

+        }

+    }

+    const auto & layer = model.layers[il];

+    bool advised = false;

+    bool failed = false;

+    for (const ggml_tensor * w : { layer.ffn_gate_exps, layer.ffn_up_exps, layer.ffn_down_exps, layer.ffn_gate_up_exps }) {

+        if (!w) {

+            continue;

+        }

+        if (id < 0 || id >= w->ne[2] || w->ne[3] != 1 || !ggml_is_contiguous(w) ||

+                w->nb[2] == 0 || !model.tensor_is_mapped(w)) {

+            if (!expert_prefetch_warned) {

+                LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_prefetch: skipping non-mmap or non-expert-contiguous tensors/invalid ids (once)\n");

+                expert_prefetch_warned = true;

+            }

+            continue;

+        }

+        static const uintptr_t page = (uintptr_t) sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

+        const uintptr_t start = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(w->data) + size_t(id) * w->nb[2];

+        if (page == 0 || page == UINTPTR_MAX || start > UINTPTR_MAX - w->nb[2] ||

+                start + w->nb[2] > UINTPTR_MAX - (page - 1)) {

+            continue;

+        }

+        const uintptr_t first = start - start % page;

+        const uintptr_t end = start + w->nb[2];

+        const uintptr_t last = end + (page - end % page) % page;

+        ++expert_prefetch_calls;

+        expert_prefetch_bytes += last - first;

+        if (madvise(reinterpret_cast<void *>(first), last - first, MADV_WILLNEED) != 0) {

+            ++expert_prefetch_failures;

+            failed = true;

+        } else {

+            advised = true;

+        }

+    }

+    if (advised && !failed) {

+        if (state.recent.size() == 32) {

+            state.recent.erase(state.recent.begin());

+        }

+        state.recent.emplace_back(id, state.tokens);

+    }

+#else

+    (void) il;

+    (void) id;

+#endif

+}

+

+void llama_context::expert_prefetch_cb(ggml_tensor * t, bool ask, bool * observe, void * data) {

+    auto & ctx = *static_cast<llama_context *>(data);

+#ifdef __linux__

+    if (ctx.expert_fill_failed) { return; }

+#endif

+    if (t->op != GGML_OP_MUL_MAT_ID || !t->src[0] || !t->src[2]) {

+        return;

+    }

+    size_t il = 0;

+    for (; il < ctx.model.layers.size(); ++il) {

+        const auto & layer = ctx.model.layers[il];

+        if (t->src[0] == layer.ffn_up_exps || t->src[0] == layer.ffn_gate_exps ||

+                t->src[0] == layer.ffn_down_exps || t->src[0] == layer.ffn_gate_up_exps) {

+            break;

+        }

+    }

+#ifdef __linux__

+    if (il < ctx.model.layers.size() && ctx.expert_diag_enabled && ctx.expert_diag_token_active &&

+            ctx.expert_prefetch_layers[il].observed) {

+        *observe = true;

+        if (!ask) { ctx.expert_diag_pre_use(il); }

+        return;

+    }

+#endif

+    if (il == ctx.model.layers.size() || ctx.expert_prefetch_layers[il].observed) {

+        return;

+    }

+    *observe = true;

+    if (ask) {

+        return;

+    }

+    auto & state = ctx.expert_prefetch_layers[il];

+    state.observed = true;

+    const ggml_tensor * ids = t->src[2];

+    const ggml_tensor * base = ids->view_src ? ids->view_src : ids;

+    if (ids->type != GGML_TYPE_I32 || ids->ne[2] != 1 || ids->ne[3] != 1 ||

+            !ids->data || !base->buffer || !ggml_backend_buffer_is_host(base->buffer) ||

+            !strstr(ids->name, "ffn_moe_topk-")) {

+        if (!ctx.expert_prefetch_warned) {

+#ifdef __linux__

+            if (ctx.expert_fill_enabled) {

+                ctx.expert_fill_failed = true;

+                LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_fill: inactive (unsupported host router ids)\n");

+            } else

+#endif

+            LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_prefetch: skipping unsupported router ids (once)\n");

+            ctx.expert_prefetch_warned = true;

+        }

+        return;

+    }

+    std::vector<int32_t> selected;

+    for (int64_t token = 0; token < ids->ne[1]; ++token) {

+        for (int64_t k = 0; k < ids->ne[0]; ++k) {

+            int32_t id;

+            memcpy(&id, static_cast<const char *>(ids->data) + token * ids->nb[1] + k * ids->nb[0], sizeof(id));

+            if (id >= 0 && id < t->src[0]->ne[2] &&

+                    std::find(selected.begin(), selected.end(), id) == selected.end()) {

+                selected.push_back(id);

+            }

+        }

+    }

+#ifdef __linux__

+    if (ctx.expert_fill_enabled) {

+        if (ctx.expert_pregate_enabled) {

+            ctx.expert_pregate_arrive(il, selected); // cancel before demand

+            if (ctx.expert_pregate_before) { ctx.expert_pregate_hook(il, t); }

+        }

+        ctx.expert_fill_selected(il, selected); // demand for L first by default

+        if (ctx.expert_pregate_enabled && !ctx.expert_pregate_before) {

+            ctx.expert_pregate_hook(il, t); // ORDER=after (default): enqueue L+1

+        }

+        if (ctx.expert_diag_enabled) { ctx.expert_diag_pre_use(il); }

+        return;

+    }

+#endif

+    state.tokens += ids->ne[1];

+    for (int32_t id : state.predicted) {

+        ++ctx.expert_prefetch_total;

+        ctx.expert_prefetch_hits += std::find(selected.begin(), selected.end(), id) != selected.end();

+    }

+    state.predicted.clear();

+    for (int32_t id : selected) {

+        ctx.expert_prefetch_advise(il, id);

+    }

+    if (ctx.expert_prefetch_next && il + 1 < ctx.model.layers.size()) {

+        auto & next = ctx.expert_prefetch_layers[il + 1];

+        const ggml_tensor * w = ctx.model.layers[il + 1].ffn_down_exps;

+        if (w && !next.observed) {

+            for (int32_t id : selected) {

+                if (id < w->ne[2]) {

+                    next.predicted.push_back(id);

+                    ctx.expert_prefetch_advise(il + 1, id);

+                }

+            }

+        }

+    }

+}

+

 llama_context::~llama_context() {

     // wait for any pending asynchronous copies into the output buffers before they are freed

+        fprintf(stderr, " thread_minflt=%llu", (unsigned long long)d.thread_minflt);

+            sum.prompt_fill_wall_ns += s.prompt_fill_wall_ns;

+            sum.decode_calls += s.decode_calls; sum.decode_bytes_read += s.decode_bytes_read;

+            sum.decode_fill_wall_ns += s.decode_fill_wall_ns;

+            sum.max_single_fill_ns = std::max(sum.max_single_fill_ns, s.max_single_fill_ns);

+        }

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_fill: stats calls=%" PRIu64 " ranges=%" PRIu64 " bytes_requested=%" PRIu64

+            " bytes_skipped_resident=%" PRIu64 " bytes_read=%" PRIu64 " read_syscalls=%" PRIu64

+            " total_fill_wall_ns=%" PRIu64 " max_single_fill_ns=%" PRIu64

+            " prompt_calls=%" PRIu64 " prompt_bytes_read=%" PRIu64 " prompt_fill_wall_ns=%" PRIu64

+            " decode_calls=%" PRIu64 " decode_bytes_read=%" PRIu64 " decode_fill_wall_ns=%" PRIu64

+            " populate_calls=%" PRIu64 " populate_ns=%" PRIu64 " populate_errors=%" PRIu64

+            " demand_wait_ns_total=%" PRIu64 " demand_wait_ns_per_token=%.3f\n",

+            sum.calls, sum.ranges, sum.bytes_requested, sum.bytes_skipped_resident, sum.bytes_read,

+            sum.read_syscalls, sum.total_fill_wall_ns, sum.max_single_fill_ns,

+            sum.prompt_calls, sum.prompt_bytes_read, sum.prompt_fill_wall_ns,

+            sum.decode_calls, sum.decode_bytes_read, sum.decode_fill_wall_ns,

+            sum.populate_calls, sum.populate_ns, sum.populate_errors,

+            sum.total_fill_wall_ns, expert_demand_tokens ? double(sum.total_fill_wall_ns)/expert_demand_tokens : 0.0);

+    }

+#endif

+    if (!expert_prefetch_layers.empty() && expert_prefetch_calls) {

+#pragma once

+// Linux buffered reads populate the same page cache as the model mmap.

+#include <algorithm>

+#include <atomic>

+#include <cstdio>

+#include <sys/resource.h>

+#ifndef MADV_POPULATE_READ

+#define MADV_POPULATE_READ 22

+#endif

+#include <cerrno>

+#include <chrono>

+#include <condition_variable>

+#include <cstdint>

+#include <cstdlib>

+#include <exception>

+#include <list>

+#include <memory>

+#include <fcntl.h>

+#include <limits>

+#include <mutex>

+#include <stdexcept>

+#include <string>

+#include <sys/mman.h>

+#include <sys/stat.h>

+#include <thread>

+#include <unistd.h>

+#include <vector>

+

+// All LLAMA_EXPERT_* settings are validated even when fill/pregate is off.

+// Decimal digits only (no signs/whitespace); 0 token limits mean unlimited.

+extern char ** environ;

+struct ExpertConfig {

+    size_t fill = 0, threads = 8, chunk_kib = 1024, min_tokens = 0, max_tokens = 0;

+    size_t diag = 0, populate = 0, pregate = 0, k = 8, max_inflight = 4, lookahead = 1;

+    size_t prefetch = 0, prefetch_next = 0;

+    std::string random = "0", order = "after", diag_csv;

+    [[noreturn]] static void invalid(const char * name, const char * value, const std::string & range) {

+        fprintf(stderr, "expert_config: invalid %s=%s (range %s)\n", name, value, range.c_str());

+        fflush(stderr);

+        std::abort(); // Deliberately outside the recoverable fill/predict exception paths.

+    }

+    static size_t integer(const char * name, size_t fallback, size_t lo, size_t hi) {

+        const char * value = getenv(name);

+        if (!value) { return fallback; }

+        size_t n = 0;

+        bool valid = *value != 0;

+        for (const char * p = value; *p; ++p) {

+            if (*p < '0' || *p > '9' || n > hi / 10 ||

+                    (n == hi / 10 && size_t(*p - '0') > hi % 10)) { valid = false; break; }

+            n = n * 10 + size_t(*p - '0');

+        }

+        if (!valid || n < lo || n > hi) {

+            invalid(name, value, std::to_string(lo) + ".." + std::to_string(hi));

+        }

+        return n;

+    }

+    static std::string choice(const char * name, const char * fallback, std::initializer_list<const char *> choices) {

+        const char * value = getenv(name);

+        if (!value) { return fallback; }

+        std::string range;

+        for (const char * c : choices) {

+            if (std::string(value) == c) { return value; }

+            if (!range.empty()) { range += "|"; }

+            range += c;

+        }

+        invalid(name, value, range);

+    }

+    static ExpertConfig read() {

+        const std::vector<std::string> known = {

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_RANDOM", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_THREADS",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_CHUNK_KIB", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MIN_TOKENS", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MAX_TOKENS",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG_CSV", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_POPULATE",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_K", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_ORDER",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_MAX_INFLIGHT", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_LOOKAHEAD",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREFETCH", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREFETCH_NEXT"};

+        for (char ** e = environ; e && *e; ++e) {

+            const std::string entry(*e);

+            const size_t eq = entry.find('=');

+            const std::string name = entry.substr(0, eq);

+            if (name.compare(0, 13, "LLAMA_EXPERT_") == 0 &&

+                    std::find(known.begin(), known.end(), name) == known.end()) {

+                invalid(name.c_str(), eq == std::string::npos ? "" : entry.c_str() + eq + 1, "known LLAMA_EXPERT_* name");

+            }

+        }

+        ExpertConfig c;

+        c.fill = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL", 0, 0, 1);

+        c.random = choice("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_RANDOM", "0", {"0", "1", "decode"});

+        c.threads = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_THREADS", 8, 1, 64);

+        c.chunk_kib = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_CHUNK_KIB", 1024, 64, 65536);

+        c.min_tokens = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MIN_TOKENS", 0, 0, 2147483647);

+        c.max_tokens = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MAX_TOKENS", 0, 0, 2147483647);

+        c.diag = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG", 0, 0, 1);

+        c.populate = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_POPULATE", 0, 0, 1);

+        if (const char * csv = getenv("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG_CSV")) {

+            if (!*csv) { invalid("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG_CSV", csv, "nonempty path"); }

+            c.diag_csv = csv;

+        }

+        c.pregate = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE", 0, 0, 1);

+        c.k = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_K", 8, 1, 32);

+        c.order = choice("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_ORDER", "after", {"after", "before"});

+        c.max_inflight = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_MAX_INFLIGHT", 4, 1, 64);

+        c.lookahead = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_LOOKAHEAD", 1, 1, 2);

+        c.prefetch = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREFETCH", 0, 0, 1);

+        c.prefetch_next = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREFETCH_NEXT", 0, 0, 1);

+        return c;

+    }

+    void print() const {

+        fprintf(stderr, "expert_config: effective fill=%zu random=%s max_tokens=%zu threads=%zu chunk_kib=%zu "

+            "pregate=%zu k=%zu order=%s max_inflight=%zu lookahead=%zu min_tokens=%zu diag=%zu populate=%zu "

+            "diag_csv=%s prefetch=%zu prefetch_next=%zu\n",

+            fill, random.c_str(), max_tokens, threads, chunk_kib, pregate, k, order.c_str(), max_inflight,

+            lookahead, min_tokens, diag, populate, diag_csv.empty() ? "(unset)" : diag_csv.c_str(), prefetch, prefetch_next);

+    }

+};

+

+class ExpertFiller {

+public:

+    struct Range { uint64_t offset; size_t len; };

+    struct Counters {

+        uint64_t populate_calls = 0, populate_ns = 0, populate_errors = 0;

+        uint64_t thread_majflt = 0, thread_minflt = 0;

+        uint64_t calls = 0, ranges = 0, bytes_requested = 0;

+        uint64_t bytes_skipped_resident = 0, bytes_read = 0, read_syscalls = 0;

+        uint64_t total_fill_wall_ns = 0, max_single_fill_ns = 0;

+        uint64_t prompt_calls = 0, prompt_bytes_read = 0, prompt_fill_wall_ns = 0;

+        uint64_t decode_calls = 0, decode_bytes_read = 0, decode_fill_wall_ns = 0;

+    };

+    struct AsyncBatch {

+        std::atomic<uint64_t> pending {0}, running {0}, bytes_read {0}, read_syscalls {0}, errors {0};

+        std::atomic<uint64_t> cancelled_jobs {0}, cancelled_bytes {0};

+    };

+    using Async = std::shared_ptr<AsyncBatch>;

+    struct AsyncCounters {

+        uint64_t bytes_read, read_syscalls, errors, dropped, cancelled_jobs, cancelled_bytes;

+        uint64_t max_inflight;

+    };

+    struct AsyncState {

+        uint64_t pending = 0, running = 0, cancelled = 0, errors = 0;

+        AsyncState & operator+=(const AsyncState & b) {

+            pending += b.pending; running += b.running; cancelled += b.cancelled; errors += b.errors;

+            return *this;

+        }

+    };

+    AsyncState async_state(const Async & batch) {

+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+        if (!batch) { return {0, 0, 1, 0}; } // rejected/unstarted, never resident

+        return {batch->pending.load(), batch->running.load(), batch->cancelled_jobs.load(), batch->errors.load()};

+    }

+    enum class Arrival { done, inflight, queued, resident };

+    // A prediction covers every tensor/file/chunk for one expert. Conservatively

+    // classify queued if ANY chunk missed dispatch; errors never count as done.

+    static Arrival classify(bool resident_at_predict, const AsyncState & state) {

+        if (resident_at_predict) { return Arrival::resident; }

+        if (state.cancelled || state.pending > state.running || state.errors) { return Arrival::queued; }

+        if (state.running) { return Arrival::inflight; }

+        return Arrival::done;

+    }

+    struct Timeliness {

+        uint64_t pred_done=0, pred_inflight=0, pred_queued=0, pred_resident_at_predict=0;

+        uint64_t hit_done=0, hit_inflight=0, hit_queued=0, hit_resident=0;

+        void record(Arrival state, bool hit) {

+            switch (state) {

+                case Arrival::done: ++pred_done; hit_done += hit; break;

+                case Arrival::inflight: ++pred_inflight; hit_inflight += hit; break;

+                case Arrival::queued: ++pred_queued; hit_queued += hit; break;

+                case Arrival::resident: ++pred_resident_at_predict; hit_resident += hit; break;

+            }

+        }

+    };

+    struct Prediction {

+        int32_t id = -1;

+        bool resident_at_predict = true;

+        std::vector<std::pair<ExpertFiller *, Async>> batches;

+        // The oracle is mincore in production, a deterministic fake in tests.

+        template<class ResidencyOracle>

+        void enqueue(ExpertFiller & filler, const std::vector<Range> & ranges, size_t layer, ResidencyOracle resident, size_t distance = 1) {

+            if (resident(ranges)) { return; }

+            resident_at_predict = false;

+            batches.emplace_back(&filler, filler.enqueue_async(ranges, layer, distance));

+        }

+        AsyncState state() const {

+            AsyncState sum;

+            for (const auto & b : batches) { sum += b.first->async_state(b.second); }

+            return sum;

+        }

+        Arrival arrive() const { return classify(resident_at_predict, state()); }

+    };

+    // mapping must be a live, offset-zero file mmap for the lifetime of this object.

+    ExpertFiller(const std::string & path, void * mapping, size_t mapping_size,

+                 const ExpertConfig & config = ExpertConfig::read())

+        : mapping_(static_cast<char *>(mapping)), size_(mapping_size),

+          threads_(config.threads), chunk_(config.chunk_kib * 1024) {

+        async_limit_ = std::min(threads_, config.max_inflight);

+        diag_ = config.diag;

+        populate_ = config.populate;

+        const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

+        if (page <= 0 || !mapping_ || reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mapping_) % page || !size_) {

+            throw std::runtime_error("invalid expert mmap");

+        }

+        page_ = size_t(page);

+        fd_ = open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);

+        if (fd_ < 0) { throw std::runtime_error("open expert file failed"); }

+        struct stat st {};

+        if (fstat(fd_, &st) || st.st_size < 0 || uint64_t(st.st_size) != size_) {

+            close(fd_); fd_ = -1;

+            throw std::runtime_error("expert file size differs from mmap");

+        }

+        try {

+            // Allocate before starting workers, so allocation failures cannot kill a worker.

+            scratch_.resize(threads_); residency_.resize(threads_);

+            for (auto & b : scratch_) { b.resize(std::max(page_, chunk_)); }

+            for (auto & b : residency_) { b.resize((std::max(page_, chunk_) + page_ - 1) / page_); }

+            for (size_t i = 0; i < threads_; ++i) { workers_.emplace_back([this, i] { worker(i); }); }

+        } catch (...) {

+            stop(); close(fd_); throw;

+        }

+    }

+    ~ExpertFiller() { wait_async(); stop(); if (fd_ >= 0) { close(fd_); } }

+    ExpertFiller(const ExpertFiller &) = delete;

+    ExpertFiller & operator=(const ExpertFiller &) = delete;

+    size_t threads() const { return threads_; }

+    size_t chunk_bytes() const { return chunk_; }

+    Counters counters() const { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(fill_mutex_); return counters_; }

+

+    // Enqueue only: no residency query, file IO, or wait for worker completion.

+    // Jobs use the existing pool, after all available synchronous jobs.

+    Async enqueue_async(const std::vector<Range> & ranges, size_t layer = 0, size_t distance = 1) {

+        std::vector<Range> jobs;

+        for (const auto & r : ranges) {

+            if (r.offset > size_ || r.len > size_ - r.offset) { throw std::out_of_range("async range outside mmap"); }

+            if (!r.len) { continue; }

+            const uint64_t first = r.offset / page_ * page_;

+            const uint64_t end = r.offset + r.len;

+            const uint64_t last = end + std::min<uint64_t>((page_ - end % page_) % page_, size_ - end);

+            const size_t step = std::max(page_, chunk_ / page_ * page_);

+            for (uint64_t at = first; at < last;) {

+                const size_t len = std::min<uint64_t>(step, last - at);

+                jobs.push_back({at, len}); at += len;

+            }

+        }

+        auto batch = std::make_shared<AsyncBatch>();

+        // Construct off-lock; splice publishes the whole submission without allocation.

+        std::list<AsyncJob> submission;

+        for (auto r : jobs) { submission.push_back({r, batch, layer, distance}); }

+        {

+            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+            // Bound speculative backlog; drop a whole submission, never block on IO.

+            if (async_queue_.size() + jobs.size() > 4096) {

+                ++async_dropped_;

+                batch->cancelled_jobs = jobs.size();

+                for (const auto & r : jobs) { batch->cancelled_bytes += r.len; }

+                async_cancelled_jobs_ += jobs.size(); async_cancelled_bytes_ += batch->cancelled_bytes.load();

+                return batch;

+            }

+            // Earliest layer deadline first; at equal deadlines prefer distance 1,

+            // then FIFO. New L+1 work precedes old distance-2 work too.

+            auto at = std::find_if(async_queue_.begin(), async_queue_.end(),

+                [layer, distance](const AsyncJob & job) {

+                    return job.layer > layer || (job.layer == layer && job.distance > distance);

+                });

+            async_queue_.splice(at, submission);

+            batch->pending = jobs.size(); async_pending_ += jobs.size();

+        }

+        ready_.notify_all();

+        return batch;

+    }

+    // Arrival deadline: retire queued chunks for this layer and older layers.

+    // The queue mutex makes cancellation atomic with worker dispatch. Running

+    // chunks retain their batch and finish normally; pending includes both kinds.

+    void cancel_async_through(size_t layer) {

+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+        cancel_async_locked(layer);

+    }

+    // Sample all observed experts and cancel their queued work under the SAME

+    // dispatch lock: a chunk classified queued cannot start before cancellation.

+    std::vector<AsyncState> arrive_async_through(size_t layer, const std::vector<Async> & observed) {

+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+        std::vector<AsyncState> states;

+        states.reserve(observed.size());

+        for (const auto & b : observed) {

+            states.push_back(b ? AsyncState {b->pending.load(), b->running.load(), b->cancelled_jobs.load(), b->errors.load()}

+                               : AsyncState {0, 0, 1, 0});

+        }

+        cancel_async_locked(layer);

+        return states;

+    }

+    // Teardown/tests only. The CPU observer never calls this.

+    void wait_async() {

+        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+        async_done_.wait(lock, [this] { return async_pending_ == 0; });

+    }

+    AsyncCounters async_counters() const {

+        return {async_bytes_.load(), async_syscalls_.load(), async_errors_.load(), async_dropped_.load(),

+                async_cancelled_jobs_.load(), async_cancelled_bytes_.load(), async_max_inflight_.load()};

+    }

+

+    bool diagnostic() const { return diag_; }

+    // Used by prediction-time residency and opt-in diagnostics. Counts page cache

+    // residency, not installed PTEs; errors are explicit rather than resident.

+    uint64_t nonresident(const std::vector<Range> & ranges) const {

+        uint64_t count = 0;

+        std::vector<Range> sorted = ranges;

+        std::sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end(), [](const Range & a, const Range & b) { return a.offset < b.offset; });

+        uint64_t checked_end = 0;

+        for (const auto & r : sorted) {

+            if (!r.len) { continue; }

+            const size_t first = std::max<uint64_t>(r.offset / page_ * page_, checked_end);

+            if (r.offset + r.len <= first) { continue; }

+            const size_t len = r.offset + r.len - first;

+            checked_end = first + ((len + page_ - 1) / page_) * page_;

+            std::vector<unsigned char> v((len + page_ - 1) / page_);

+            if (mincore(mapping_ + first, len, v.data())) { throw std::runtime_error("expert residency mincore failed"); }

+            for (auto b : v) { count += !(b & 1); }

+        }

+        return count;

+    }

+    uint64_t fill(const std::vector<Range> & ranges, bool decode = false) {

+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> serial(fill_mutex_);

+        // Reserve scheduling priority before residency queries/job construction,

+        // not just after demand jobs are published. In-flight async IO may finish.

+        DemandScope demand(*this);

+        const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

+        batch_diag_ = diag_ && decode;

+        ++counters_.calls;

+        ++(decode ? counters_.decode_calls : counters_.prompt_calls);

+        const uint64_t bytes_before = counters_.bytes_read;

+        counters_.ranges += ranges.size();

+        auto finish = [&] {

+            const uint64_t ns = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(

+                std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();

+            counters_.total_fill_wall_ns += ns;

+            (decode ? counters_.decode_fill_wall_ns : counters_.prompt_fill_wall_ns) += ns;

+            (decode ? counters_.decode_bytes_read : counters_.prompt_bytes_read) += counters_.bytes_read - bytes_before;

+            counters_.max_single_fill_ns = std::max(counters_.max_single_fill_ns, ns);

+        };

+        try {

+            std::vector<Range> aligned;

+            for (const auto & r : ranges) {

+                if (r.offset > size_ || r.len > size_ - r.offset) { throw std::out_of_range("expert range outside mmap"); }

+                if (!r.len) { continue; }

+                const uint64_t first = r.offset - r.offset % page_;

+                const uint64_t end = r.offset + r.len;

+                const size_t pad = (page_ - end % page_) % page_;

+                const uint64_t last = end + std::min<uint64_t>(pad, size_ - end);

+                aligned.push_back({first, size_t(last - first)});

+            }

+            std::sort(aligned.begin(), aligned.end(), [](const Range & a, const Range & b) { return a.offset < b.offset; });

+            std::vector<Range> merged;

+            for (const auto & r : aligned) {

+                if (!merged.empty() && r.offset <= merged.back().offset + merged.back().len) {

+                    auto & b = merged.back();

+                    b.len = size_t(std::max(b.offset + b.len, r.offset + r.len) - b.offset);

+                } else { merged.push_back(r); }

+            }

+            std::vector<Range> jobs;

+            for (const auto & r : merged) {

+                counters_.bytes_requested += r.len; // page-aligned union, once per fill

+                const size_t pages = r.len / page_ + (r.len % page_ != 0);

+                std::vector<unsigned char> resident(pages);

+                if (mincore(mapping_ + r.offset, r.len, resident.data())) { throw std::runtime_error("expert mincore failed"); }

+                size_t run = 0;

+                while (run < pages) {

+                    if (resident[run] & 1) {

+                        counters_.bytes_skipped_resident += std::min(page_, r.len - run * page_);

+                        ++run; continue;

+                    }

+                    const size_t first = run++;

+                    while (run < pages && !(resident[run] & 1)) { ++run; }

+                    const size_t end = std::min(r.len, run * page_);

+                    for (size_t pos = first * page_; pos < end;) {

+                        const size_t len = std::min(chunk_, end - pos);

+                        jobs.push_back({r.offset + pos, len}); pos += len;

+                    }

+                }

+            }

+            {

+                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+                populating_ = false;

+                jobs_ = std::move(jobs); next_ = 0; pending_ = jobs_.size(); error_ = 0;

+                ready_.notify_all();

+                done_.wait(lock, [this] { return pending_ == 0; });

+                counters_.bytes_read += batch_bytes_; counters_.read_syscalls += batch_syscalls_;

+                batch_bytes_ = batch_syscalls_ = 0;

+                if (error_) { throw std::runtime_error("expert pread failed: errno=" + std::to_string(error_)); }

+                // All preads finish before populate, including ranges already resident.

+                if (populate_.load() && !populate_unsupported().load()) {

+                    jobs_.clear();

+                    for (const auto & r : merged) {

+                        for (size_t pos = 0; pos < r.len;) {

+                            const size_t populate_chunk = std::max(page_, chunk_ / page_ * page_);

+                            const size_t len = std::min(populate_chunk, r.len - pos);

+                            jobs_.push_back({r.offset + pos, len}); pos += len;

+                        }

+                    }

+                    populating_ = true; next_ = 0; pending_ = jobs_.size();

+                    ready_.notify_all();

+                    done_.wait(lock, [this] { return pending_ == 0; });

+                    if (error_) { throw std::runtime_error("expert populate failed: errno=" + std::to_string(error_)); }

+                }

+            }

+        } catch (...) { finish(); throw; }

+        finish();

+        return counters_.bytes_read - bytes_before;

+    }

+private:

+    friend struct ExpertFillerTestAccess;

+    struct DemandScope {

+        ExpertFiller & owner;

+        explicit DemandScope(ExpertFiller & f) : owner(f) {

+            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(owner.mutex_); owner.demand_active_ = true;

+        }

+        ~DemandScope() {

+            { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(owner.mutex_); owner.demand_active_ = false; }

+            owner.ready_.notify_all();

+        }

+    };

+    static std::atomic<bool> & populate_unsupported() {

+        static std::atomic<bool> value {false}; return value;

+    }

+    // mutex_ must be held, including while taking arrival snapshots.

+    void cancel_async_locked(size_t layer) {

+        for (auto it = async_queue_.begin(); it != async_queue_.end();) {

+            if (it->layer > layer) { ++it; continue; }

+            ++it->batch->cancelled_jobs; it->batch->cancelled_bytes += it->range.len;

+            ++async_cancelled_jobs_; async_cancelled_bytes_ += it->range.len;

+            --it->batch->pending; --async_pending_;

+            it = async_queue_.erase(it);

+        }

+        if (!async_pending_) { async_done_.notify_all(); }

+    }

+    void stop() {

+        { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_); stopping_ = true; }

+        ready_.notify_all();

+        for (auto & t : workers_) { t.join(); }

+    }

+    void worker(size_t index) {

+        for (;;) {

+            Range job {};

+            Async async;

+            bool diagnostic = false, populating = false;

+            {

+                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+                ready_.wait(lock, [this] { return stopping_ || next_ < jobs_.size() ||

+                    (!demand_active_ && !async_queue_.empty() && async_running_ < async_limit_); });

+                if (stopping_) { return; }

+                if (next_ < jobs_.size()) {

+                    job = jobs_[next_++]; diagnostic = batch_diag_; populating = populating_;

+                } else {

+                    job = async_queue_.front().range; async = async_queue_.front().batch;

+                    async_queue_.pop_front(); ++async->running;

+                    ++async_running_;

+                    async_max_inflight_.store(std::max<uint64_t>(async_max_inflight_.load(), async_running_));

+                }

+            }

+            size_t bytes = 0; uint64_t syscalls = 0; int error = 0;

+            struct rusage before {}, after {};

+            if (diagnostic) { getrusage(RUSAGE_THREAD, &before); }

+            uint64_t populate_ns = 0, populate_calls = 0, populate_errors = 0;

+            if (populating) {

+                if (populate_.load() && !populate_unsupported().load()) {

+                    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

+                    ++populate_calls;

+                    if (madvise(mapping_ + job.offset, job.len, MADV_POPULATE_READ)) {

+                        ++populate_errors;

+                        if (errno == EINVAL) {

+                            populate_.store(false);

+                            if (!populate_unsupported().exchange(true)) { fprintf(stderr, "expert_fill: populate unsupported\n"); }

+                        } else { error = errno; }

+                    }

+                    populate_ns = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(

+                        std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();

+                }

+            } else if (async) {

+                // Query at consumption time, including when sync filled these pages meanwhile.

+                auto & resident = residency_[index];

+                if (mincore(mapping_ + job.offset, job.len, resident.data())) { error = errno; }

+                size_t pos = 0;

+                while (!error && pos < job.len) {

+                    if (resident[pos / page_] & 1) { pos = std::min(job.len, pos + page_); continue; }

+                    const size_t first = pos;

+                    do { pos = std::min(job.len, pos + page_); }

+                    while (pos < job.len && !(resident[pos / page_] & 1));

+                    size_t at = first;

+                    while (at < pos) {

+                        ++syscalls;

+                        const ssize_t n = pread(fd_, scratch_[index].data() + at, pos - at, off_t(job.offset + at));

+                        if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) { continue; }

+                        if (n <= 0) { error = n < 0 ? errno : EIO; break; }

+                        at += size_t(n); bytes += size_t(n);

+                    }

+                }

+            } else while (bytes < job.len) {

+                ++syscalls;

+                const ssize_t n = pread(fd_, scratch_[index].data() + bytes, job.len - bytes, off_t(job.offset + bytes));

+                if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) { continue; }

+                if (n <= 0) { error = n < 0 ? errno : EIO; break; }

+                bytes += size_t(n);

+            }

+            if (diagnostic) { getrusage(RUSAGE_THREAD, &after); }

+            {

+                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+                if (async) {

+                    async->bytes_read += bytes; async->read_syscalls += syscalls;

+                    async->errors += error != 0;

+                    async_bytes_ += bytes; async_syscalls_ += syscalls; async_errors_ += error != 0;

+                    --async->running; --async->pending; --async_running_;

+                    ready_.notify_all(); // a capped async slot is now available

+                    if (--async_pending_ == 0) { async_done_.notify_all(); }

+                    continue;

+                }

+                counters_.populate_calls += populate_calls; counters_.populate_ns += populate_ns;

+                counters_.populate_errors += populate_errors;

+                if (diagnostic) {

+                    counters_.thread_majflt += after.ru_majflt - before.ru_majflt;

+                    counters_.thread_minflt += after.ru_minflt - before.ru_minflt;

+                }

+                batch_bytes_ += bytes; batch_syscalls_ += syscalls;

+                if (error && !error_) { error_ = error; }

+                if (--pending_ == 0) { done_.notify_one(); }

+            }

+        }

+    }

+    int fd_ = -1;

+    char * mapping_;

+    size_t size_, threads_, chunk_, page_ = 0;

+    mutable std::mutex fill_mutex_;

+    std::mutex mutex_;

+    std::condition_variable ready_, done_, async_done_;

+    struct AsyncJob { Range range; Async batch; size_t layer, distance; };

+    std::list<AsyncJob> async_queue_;

+    size_t async_pending_ = 0, async_running_ = 0, async_limit_ = 4;

+    bool demand_active_ = false;

+    std::atomic<uint64_t> async_bytes_ {0}, async_syscalls_ {0}, async_errors_ {0}, async_dropped_ {0};

+    std::atomic<uint64_t> async_cancelled_jobs_ {0}, async_cancelled_bytes_ {0}, async_max_inflight_ {0};

+    std::vector<std::thread> workers_;

+    std::vector<std::vector<char>> scratch_;

+    std::vector<std::vector<unsigned char>> residency_;

+    std::vector<Range> jobs_;

+    size_t next_ = 0, pending_ = 0;

+    bool stopping_ = false, diag_ = false, batch_diag_ = false, populating_ = false;

+    std::atomic<bool> populate_ {false};

+    int error_ = 0;

+    uint64_t batch_bytes_ = 0, batch_syscalls_ = 0;

+    Counters counters_;

+};

+#include <thread>

+#include <unistd.h>

+class ExpertFiller {

+public:

+    struct Range { uint64_t offset; size_t len; };

+    struct Counters {

+        uint64_t calls = 0, ranges = 0, bytes_requested = 0;

+        uint64_t bytes_skipped_resident = 0, bytes_read = 0, read_syscalls = 0;

+        uint64_t total_fill_wall_ns = 0, max_single_fill_ns = 0;

+    };

+    // mapping must be a live, offset-zero file mmap for the lifetime of this object.

+    ExpertFiller(const std::string & path, void * mapping, size_t mapping_size)

+        : mapping_(static_cast<char *>(mapping)), size_(mapping_size),

+          threads_(env_size("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_THREADS", 8, 256)),

+          chunk_(env_size("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_CHUNK_KIB", 1024, 65536) * 1024) {

+        const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

+        if (page <= 0 || !mapping_ || reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mapping_) % page || !size_) {

+            throw std::runtime_error("invalid expert mmap");

+        }

+        page_ = size_t(page);

+        fd_ = open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);

+        if (fd_ < 0) { throw std::runtime_error("open expert file failed"); }

+        struct stat st {};

+        if (fstat(fd_, &st) || st.st_size < 0 || uint64_t(st.st_size) != size_) {

+            close(fd_); fd_ = -1;

+            throw std::runtime_error("expert file size differs from mmap");

+        }

+        try {

+            // Allocate before starting workers, so allocation failures cannot kill a worker.

+            scratch_.resize(threads_);

+            for (auto & b : scratch_) { b.resize(chunk_); }

+            for (size_t i = 0; i < threads_; ++i) { workers_.emplace_back([this, i] { worker(i); }); }

+        } catch (...) {

+            stop(); close(fd_); throw;

+        }

+    }

+    ~ExpertFiller() { stop(); if (fd_ >= 0) { close(fd_); } }

+    ExpertFiller(const ExpertFiller &) = delete;

+    ExpertFiller & operator=(const ExpertFiller &) = delete;

+    size_t threads() const { return threads_; }

+    size_t chunk_bytes() const { return chunk_; }

+    Counters counters() const { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(fill_mutex_); return counters_; }

+

+    void fill(const std::vector<Range> & ranges) {

+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> serial(fill_mutex_);

+        const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

+        ++counters_.calls;

+        counters_.ranges += ranges.size();

+        auto finish = [&] {

+            const uint64_t ns = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(

+                std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();

+            counters_.total_fill_wall_ns += ns;

+            counters_.max_single_fill_ns = std::max(counters_.max_single_fill_ns, ns);

+        };

+        try {

+            std::vector<Range> aligned;

+            for (const auto & r : ranges) {

+                if (r.offset > size_ || r.len > size_ - r.offset) { throw std::out_of_range("expert range outside mmap"); }

+                if (!r.len) { continue; }

+                const uint64_t first = r.offset - r.offset % page_;

+                const uint64_t end = r.offset + r.len;

+                const size_t pad = (page_ - end % page_) % page_;

+                const uint64_t last = end + std::min<uint64_t>(pad, size_ - end);

+                aligned.push_back({first, size_t(last - first)});

+            }

+            std::sort(aligned.begin(), aligned.end(), [](const Range & a, const Range & b) { return a.offset < b.offset; });

+            std::vector<Range> merged;

+            for (const auto & r : aligned) {

+                if (!merged.empty() && r.offset <= merged.back().offset + merged.back().len) {

+                    auto & b = merged.back();

+                    b.len = size_t(std::max(b.offset + b.len, r.offset + r.len) - b.offset);

+                } else { merged.push_back(r); }

+            }

+            std::vector<Range> jobs;

+            for (const auto & r : merged) {

+                counters_.bytes_requested += r.len; // page-aligned union, once per fill

+                const size_t pages = r.len / page_ + (r.len % page_ != 0);

+                std::vector<unsigned char> resident(pages);

+                if (mincore(mapping_ + r.offset, r.len, resident.data())) { throw std::runtime_error("expert mincore failed"); }

+                size_t run = 0;

+                while (run < pages) {

+                    if (resident[run] & 1) {

+                        counters_.bytes_skipped_resident += std::min(page_, r.len - run * page_);

+                        ++run; continue;

+                    }

+                    const size_t first = run++;

+                    while (run < pages && !(resident[run] & 1)) { ++run; }

+                    const size_t end = std::min(r.len, run * page_);

+                    for (size_t pos = first * page_; pos < end;) {

+                        const size_t len = std::min(chunk_, end - pos);

+                        jobs.push_back({r.offset + pos, len}); pos += len;

+                    }

+                }

+            }

+            {

+                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+                jobs_ = std::move(jobs); next_ = 0; pending_ = jobs_.size(); error_ = 0;

+                ready_.notify_all();

+                done_.wait(lock, [this] { return pending_ == 0; });

+                counters_.bytes_read += batch_bytes_; counters_.read_syscalls += batch_syscalls_;

+                batch_bytes_ = batch_syscalls_ = 0;

+                if (error_) { throw std::runtime_error("expert pread failed: errno=" + std::to_string(error_)); }

+            }

+        } catch (...) { finish(); throw; }

+        finish();

+    }

+private:

+    static size_t env_size(const char * name, size_t fallback, size_t maximum) {

+        const char * s = getenv(name);

+        if (!s || !*s || *s == '-') { return fallback; }

+        char * end = nullptr; errno = 0;

+        const auto n = strtoull(s, &end, 10);

+        return errno || *end || n == 0 || n > maximum ? fallback : size_t(n);

+    }

+    void stop() {

+        { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_); stopping_ = true; }

+        ready_.notify_all();

+    }

+    void worker(size_t index) {

+        for (;;) {

+            Range job {};

+            {

+                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+                ready_.wait(lock, [this] { return stopping_ || next_ < jobs_.size(); });

+                if (stopping_) { return; }

+                bytes += size_t(n);

+            }

+            {

+                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

+                batch_bytes_ += bytes; batch_syscalls_ += syscalls;

+                if (error && !error_) { error_ = error; }

+                if (--pending_ == 0) { done_.notify_one(); }

+            }

+        }

+    }

+    int fd_ = -1;

+    char * mapping_;

+    size_t size_, threads_, chunk_, page_ = 0;

+    mutable std::mutex fill_mutex_;

+    std::mutex mutex_;

+    std::condition_variable ready_, done_;

+    std::vector<std::thread> workers_;

+    std::vector<std::vector<char>> scratch_;

+    std::vector<Range> jobs_;

+    size_t next_ = 0, pending_ = 0;

+    bool stopping_ = false;

+    int error_ = 0;

+    uint64_t batch_bytes_ = 0, batch_syscalls_ = 0;

+    Counters counters_;

+};

+// Qwen35MoE (the Qwen3.6 GGUF uses this arch):

+// x_L = RMSNorm(attention_L + residual_L, attn_post_norm_L, eps).

+// logits = W*x, p = softmax(logits), ids = topk(p); no gate_inp_b,

+// no exp_probs_b, no groups. Selected weights are normalized AFTER top-k.

+// softmax is monotone, so ranking logits gives the same IDs (ties by ID).

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_init() {

+    const char * env = getenv("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE");

+    if (!env || strcmp(env, "1") != 0) { return; }

+    try {

+        if (model.arch != LLM_ARCH_QWEN35MOE || model.hparams.n_expert_groups > 1 || !loras->empty() || !model.hdmd.rot.empty()) {

+            throw std::runtime_error("pregate requires qwen35moe without groups, LoRA, or folded rotations");

+        }

+        const char * k = getenv("LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_K");

+        if (k && strcmp(k, "12") == 0) { expert_pregate_k = 12; }

+        else if (k && strcmp(k, "16") == 0) { expert_pregate_k = 16; }

+        expert_pregate_layers.resize(model.hparams.n_layer()); // excludes unexecuted MTP blocks

+        const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

+        if (page <= 0) { throw std::runtime_error("invalid page size"); }

+        // Decode/copy from file once, never GPU tensor data. Original mmap may have holes.

+        for (size_t il = 1; il < expert_pregate_layers.size(); ++il) {

+            const auto * w = model.layers[il].ffn_gate_inp;

+            llama_model::expert_file_range info;

+            if (!w || !ggml_is_contiguous(w) || w->ne[0] != model.hparams.n_embd ||

+                    w->ne[1] != model.hparams.n_expert || w->ne[2] != 1 || w->ne[3] != 1 ||

+                    !model.expert_file_info(w, info, false)) {

+                throw std::runtime_error("router file offsets/layout unavailable");

+            }

+            const auto * traits = ggml_get_type_traits(w->type);

+            if (w->type != GGML_TYPE_F32 && !traits->to_float) {

+                throw std::runtime_error("router type has no CPU decoder");

+            }

+            auto & dst = expert_pregate_layers[il].router;

+            dst.resize(ggml_nelements(w));

+            const size_t first = info.offset / size_t(page) * size_t(page);

+            const size_t delta = info.offset - first, len = delta + ggml_nbytes(w);

+            void * ptr = mmap(nullptr, len, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, info.source_fd, off_t(first));

+            if (ptr == MAP_FAILED) { throw std::runtime_error("router file mmap failed"); }

+            const char * data = static_cast<const char *>(ptr) + delta;

+            if (w->type == GGML_TYPE_F32) { memcpy(dst.data(), data, ggml_nbytes(w)); }

+            else {

+                for (int64_t row = 0; row < w->ne[1]; ++row) {

+                    traits->to_float(data + row * w->nb[1], dst.data() + row * w->ne[0], w->ne[0]);

+                }

+            }

+            munmap(ptr, len);

+        }

+        expert_pregate_enabled = true;

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: active k=%zu arch=qwen35moe gating=softmax router=file-cpu-copy\n", expert_pregate_k);

+    } catch (const std::exception & e) {

+        expert_pregate_layers.clear();

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: inactive (%s)\n", e.what());

+    }

+}

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_hook(size_t il, const ggml_tensor * t, const std::vector<int32_t> & selected) {

+    if (!expert_fill_decode || !expert_fill_this_ubatch || il >= expert_pregate_layers.size()) { return; }

+    auto & current = expert_pregate_layers[il];

+    if (!current.predicted.empty()) {

+        ++pregate_arrivals;

+        pregate_actual += selected.size(); pregate_predicted += current.predicted.size();

+        for (auto id : selected) {

+            pregate_hits += std::find(current.predicted.begin(), current.predicted.end(), id) != current.predicted.end();

+        }

+        uint64_t pending = 0, running = 0;

+        for (const auto & batch : current.batches) {

+            if (batch) { pending += batch->pending.load(); running += batch->running.load(); }

+        }

+        pregate_pending_reads += pending;

+        pregate_inflight_reads += running; pregate_inflight_arrivals += pending != 0;

+    }

+    if (expert_pregate_failed || il + 1 >= expert_pregate_layers.size()) { return; }

+    try {

+        if (!loras->empty()) { throw std::runtime_error("LoRA activated after pregate initialization"); }

+        // Before-node CPU callback runs AFTER the scheduler's host copies and prefix

+        // synchronize. src[1] of the FIRST gate/up MUL_MAT_ID is [embd,1,1,1],

+        // a reshape/host copy of attn_post_norm, not the down-projection activation.

+        const ggml_tensor * x = t->src[1];

+        const ggml_tensor * base = x && x->view_src ? x->view_src : x;

+        const auto * w = model.layers[il + 1].ffn_gate_inp;

+        if (!x || !base || !base->buffer || !ggml_backend_buffer_is_host(base->buffer) ||

+                !x->data || x->type != GGML_TYPE_F32 || x->ne[0] != w->ne[0] ||

+                x->ne[1] != 1 || x->ne[2] != 1 || x->ne[3] != 1 || !ggml_is_contiguous(x) ||

+                (t->src[0] != model.layers[il].ffn_up_exps && t->src[0] != model.layers[il].ffn_gate_exps &&

+                 t->src[0] != model.layers[il].ffn_gate_up_exps)) {

+            throw std::runtime_error("first expert input is not a host F32 decode MoE vector");

+        }

+        const auto & router = expert_pregate_layers[il + 1].router;

+        const auto * input = static_cast<const float *>(x->data);

+        std::vector<std::pair<float, int32_t>> logits;

+        logits.reserve(w->ne[1]);

+        for (int64_t e = 0; e < w->ne[1]; ++e) {

+            float dot = 0;

+            for (int64_t j = 0; j < w->ne[0]; ++j) { dot += router[e * w->ne[0] + j] * input[j]; }

+            if (!std::isfinite(dot)) { throw std::runtime_error("nonfinite pregate logits"); }

+            logits.emplace_back(dot, int32_t(e));

+        }

+        const size_t k = std::min(expert_pregate_k, logits.size());

+        std::partial_sort(logits.begin(), logits.begin() + k, logits.end(), [](const auto & a, const auto & b) {

+            return a.first != b.first ? a.first > b.first : a.second < b.second;

+        });

+        auto & next = expert_pregate_layers[il + 1];

+        next.predicted.clear(); next.batches.clear();

+        for (size_t i = 0; i < k; ++i) { next.predicted.push_back(logits[i].second); }

+        std::map<size_t, std::vector<ExpertFiller::Range>> ranges;

+        const auto & layer = model.layers[il + 1];

+        for (const ggml_tensor * expert : {layer.ffn_gate_exps, layer.ffn_up_exps, layer.ffn_down_exps, layer.ffn_gate_up_exps}) {

+            if (!expert) { continue; }

+            llama_model::expert_file_range info;

+            if (!model.expert_file_info(expert, info)) { throw std::runtime_error("pregate expert offsets unavailable"); }

+            for (auto id : next.predicted) {

+                if (id < 0 || id >= expert->ne[2]) { throw std::runtime_error("pregate expert ID outside tensor"); }

+                ranges[info.file_index].push_back({info.offset + size_t(id) * expert->nb[2], expert->nb[2]});

+            }

+        }

+        // Never fill()/wait_async() here: enqueue takes only a short queue mutex.

+        // The existing synchronous fill below is unchanged and may duplicate in-flight preads.

+        for (const auto & entry : ranges) {

+            next.batches.push_back(expert_fillers.at(entry.first)->enqueue_async(entry.second));

+        }

+        ++pregate_predictions;

+    } catch (const std::exception & e) {

+        ++pregate_skips; expert_pregate_failed = true;

+        LLAMA_LOG_INFO("expert_pregate: prediction disabled (%s)\n", e.what());

+    }

+}

+void llama_context::expert_pregate_stats() {

+// All LLAMA_EXPERT_* settings are validated even when fill/pregate is off.

+// Decimal digits only (no signs/whitespace); 0 token limits mean unlimited.

+extern char ** environ;

+struct ExpertConfig {

+    size_t fill = 0, threads = 8, chunk_kib = 1024, min_tokens = 0, max_tokens = 0;

+    size_t diag = 0, populate = 0, pregate = 0, k = 8, max_inflight = 4, lookahead = 1;

+    size_t prefetch = 0, prefetch_next = 0;

+    std::string random = "0", order = "after", diag_csv;

+    [[noreturn]] static void invalid(const char * name, const char * value, const std::string & range) {

+        fprintf(stderr, "expert_config: invalid %s=%s (range %s)\n", name, value, range.c_str());

+        fflush(stderr);

+        std::abort(); // Deliberately outside the recoverable fill/predict exception paths.

+    }

+    static size_t integer(const char * name, size_t fallback, size_t lo, size_t hi) {

+        const char * value = getenv(name);

+        if (!value) { return fallback; }

+        size_t n = 0;

+        bool valid = *value != 0;

+        for (const char * p = value; *p; ++p) {

+            if (*p < '0' || *p > '9' || n > hi / 10 ||

+                    (n == hi / 10 && size_t(*p - '0') > hi % 10)) { valid = false; break; }

+            n = n * 10 + size_t(*p - '0');

+        }

+        if (!valid || n < lo || n > hi) {

+            invalid(name, value, std::to_string(lo) + ".." + std::to_string(hi));

+        }

+        return n;

+    }

+    static std::string choice(const char * name, const char * fallback, std::initializer_list<const char *> choices) {

+        const char * value = getenv(name);

+        if (!value) { return fallback; }

+        std::string range;

+        for (const char * c : choices) {

+            if (std::string(value) == c) { return value; }

+            if (!range.empty()) { range += "|"; }

+            range += c;

+        }

+        invalid(name, value, range);

+    }

+    static ExpertConfig read() {

+        const std::vector<std::string> known = {

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_RANDOM", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_THREADS",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_CHUNK_KIB", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MIN_TOKENS", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MAX_TOKENS",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG_CSV", "LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_POPULATE",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_K", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_ORDER",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_MAX_INFLIGHT", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREGATE_LOOKAHEAD",

+            "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREFETCH", "LLAMA_EXPERT_PREFETCH_NEXT"};

+        for (char ** e = environ; e && *e; ++e) {

+            const std::string entry(*e);

+            const size_t eq = entry.find('=');

+            const std::string name = entry.substr(0, eq);

+            if (name.compare(0, 13, "LLAMA_EXPERT_") == 0 &&

+                    std::find(known.begin(), known.end(), name) == known.end()) {

+                invalid(name.c_str(), eq == std::string::npos ? "" : entry.c_str() + eq + 1, "known LLAMA_EXPERT_* name");

+            }

+        }

+        ExpertConfig c;

+        c.fill = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL", 0, 0, 1);

+        c.random = choice("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_RANDOM", "0", {"0", "1", "decode"});

+        c.threads = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_THREADS", 8, 1, 64);

+        c.chunk_kib = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_CHUNK_KIB", 1024, 64, 65536);

+        c.min_tokens = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MIN_TOKENS", 0, 0, 2147483647);

+        c.max_tokens = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_MAX_TOKENS", 0, 0, 2147483647);

+        c.diag = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_DIAG", 0, 0, 1);

+        c.populate = integer("LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL_POPULATE", 0, 0, 1);

depends_on:

- expert_fill

- expert_pregate
